memoryBuilder.verseText: While the son was still far off, his father saw him and ran to meet him and hugged him.

sequence.prompt: What happened to the lost son? Put the story in order.

matches.prompt: Match what the father did when the son came back.

pairs.right: He ran to meet his son

application.question: The father RAN to his son before the son could finish saying sorry. What does that show you about God?

options.label: God is always ready to forgive

application.followUp: God is all of those things! He is patient, He loves us first, and He is always ready to welcome us back. You never have to earn your way back to God — He is already running toward you.
